provenance.new_link_packets: Real ICMP and UDP packets through isolated Linux veth/NetEm links; no flexiEdge/VPP/overlay in path; not ISP data
provenance.previous_flexiedge_exploratory: Already inspected historical flexiEdge probes; not new confirmation
provenance.synthetic: 115 simulator episodes from predeclared seed block310000; no packets

measurements.rtt_jitter_loss: 100 ICMP probes at 20 ms spacing; RTT mean and population stddev
measurements.utilization: measured source veth TX bytes / actual elapsed interval / capacity; not VPP

protocol.split_rule: whole chronological episodes; all WANs together; no cross-episode windows
protocol.acceptance: at least 2% MAE gain, >=3 episode groups, >=30 windows, paired episode-block 95% CI upper<0

limitations: Three acceptance and three holdout episode groups are a small single-machine sample, even though seeds and conditions vary.
The new packet experiment tests link forecasting only; utilization is veth TX rate and cannot validate VPP counter compatibility.
The scenario schedule and seeds are never model features; only measured histories are supplied.
No holdout result selects parameters, weights or another candidate.
Forecast MAE gains alone do not demonstrate application, routing or SLA improvement.
KVM was unavailable; no new end-to-end flexiEdge packet trial was possible on this date.
Historical GUI images are from the10October recording; no new VSCode screenshot was obtained.
Underlying TX byte counters per sample were not retained; utilization values are persisted derived measurements.
